Reach truck AGV (BT Reflex Autopilot RAE160/RAE250 family). Specs from CURRENT official Toyota datasheet (TMHI Version 3.2, 2024-04-23; RAE200 dropped from current range). RAE250 = 2500kg rated (2300kg in auto mode at 650mm load centre); wheelbase 1575mm; service weight 4830kg. Overall length l1 = 2755mm; overall width 1270mm (900mm support-arm spread) / 1470mm (1100mm). Max lift height h23 = 12,000mm with Triplex Hi-Lo D mast (h3 lift 11,945mm; mast extended h4 = 12,546mm); Triplex Hi-Lo C mast tops at 9,000mm. Travel speed (auto mode) 2.5 m/s drive direction, 1.9 m/s fork direction. Max gradeability 7%. Battery 48V/420Ah; auto-charging Lithium-Ion standard (lead-acid also orderable across range). Turning radius (rotate on point) 1903mm. Min aisle Ast (auto mode, rotate on point, PPS muted, 800×1200 short-side, Triplex-C 419) = 3071mm (Triplex-D = 3123mm). Fork 45/125/1250mm, carriage ISO 2328 class 2A. Features: automatic load/unload, vertical + deep stacking, RS150 handling; load presence & push detection (standard); advanced vision-aided load handling / multi-load detection / barcode scanner (optional); auto charging Li-Ion; information display. forks_free_floating=TRUE (reach truck rule). Navigation: 'Laser precision navigation' (reflector-based for high-bay precision); range also supports natural/dual. Safety: CAT3 PLd, laser class 1 (IEC 60825-1), sound 62 dB(A). Op temp 0–40°C. NOTE: earlier v7 (2021) datasheet listed only up to 10,000mm lift and 2.0 m/s — both superseded by this v3.2 sheet.
